runners.name: Colonel Jack

runners.spotlight: 0-7 (0-4 over hurdles) but he went close over C&D (heavy) in December on his second hurdle start and again ran well when third at Ayr (2m4f, soft) recently; has shown promise on good to soft ground; leading claims.

runners.comment: Has shown some ability but he's been pulled up on his last two starts

runners.comment: 0-11 under rules and exposed but he's in with an each-way shout this afternoon
runners.name: Wise Move

runners.comment: Showed promise in 2022 but was then absent until this January when pulled up at Leicester

runners.name: Culzean

runners.name: Rightbackatyou

runners.comment: Runner-up in this 12 months ago; yet to fire this term but not discounted back here

runners.comment: Not easy to catch right over hurdles this term; goes chasing now and others appeal more

runners.spotlight: A two-time winner (around 2m) either side of Christmas and he has continued in good nick, failing to stay when stepped up to 2m5f at Kelso last month; this C&D winner can bounce back.

runners.comment: Running well when unseating 2 out on h'cap debut at Haydock latest; firmly in the picture

runners.comment: Yet to fire in a pair of 2m handicaps before Christmas; has plenty to prove after a break

runners.spotlight: Upwardly mobile hurdler who readily made it two wins in his last three starts in 2m1f handicap at Carlisle last month; has more to offer, so not taken lightly despite a 9lb weights hike.

runners.name: Fromheretoeternity

runners.comment: Off the mark at Doncaster 25 days ago; this demands another personal best off 5lb higher

runners.comment: Scored at Ayr in November but well below par all three runs since; others are preferred
runners.name: Dees Getaway
runners.spotlight: Scored at Ayr (2m) in November on just her second run for current yard but well below par all three runs since, only 11th at Carlisle (2m1f) last month; others are preferred.

runners.comment: Well-held fourth on yard debut at Musselburgh in December; goes h'capping with more needed
runners.name: Barrakilla Vage

runners.comment: Exploited a reduced mark to win readily at Bangor last month; 9lb rise might not stop him

runners.name: Our Laura B

runners.comment: Off nine months but recorded his best effort when third at Carlisle latest; in the mix
runners.name: Do Ye Wanna

runners.spotlight: Last of seven in 2m4f handicap at Sedgefield 15 days ago; very hard to make a case for in his bid for a maiden win from 4lb out of the handicap.

runners.spotlight: He's down to a dangerous mark and showed some spark at Haydock in December three starts ago; however, two disappointing performances have followed from this 10yo and he needs to get back on track.

runners.name: Chapel Green
runners.spotlight: Hard to fancy on what he's shown on his last three starts but the step back up in trip may help and he's 1lb lower than when winning over 2m5f at Kelso in September; not written off.

runners.spotlight: Finally off the mark when beating Desiderata at Wolverhampton a month ago; always in the right place in a messy affair (first-time visor) that night and history suggests he's no good thing to reproduce the effort.

runners.comment: Drop back to 1m didn't work in his favour here last time and he holds each-way claims
runners.name: Iftikhaar
runners.spotlight: A few near-misses to his name over C&D down the years; the drop back to 1m didn't work in his favour here last time and he holds each-way claims.

runners.comment: Two of these behind when springing a surprise over C&D in January; not as good since
runners.name: Kaaress
runners.spotlight: Two of these behind when springing a surprise over C&D in January (first-time visor, switched from cheekpieces); not as good since and is some way down the pecking order.

runners.comment: Goes well here; more likely than most at this level to give his running; each-way shout
runners.name: Monks Mead
runners.spotlight: Goes well round here (AW and turf), including when just holding off Iftikhaar in a weak affair over C&D in January; continued in form since and is more likely than most at this level to give his running; each-way shout.

runners.breeder: Mrs S M Rogers & Sir Thomas Pilkington
runners.comment: Excuses for his only below-par effort this year (C&D); on the shortlist under Rossa Ryan
runners.name: Myna
runners.spotlight: Best of those to race on the pace at Newcastle two weeks ago; excuses for his only below-par effort this year (C&D) and goes on the shortlist under Rossa Ryan.

runners.comment: In good form of late and again looked worth another try at this longer trip last time
runners.name: Spirit Charmer
runners.spotlight: In good form of late and again looked worth another try at this longer trip when just behind Monks Mead over 1m here four weeks ago; had plenty of chances now though.

14:30.race_name: Hereford Easter Monday Family Raceday Handicap Chase

runners.comment: Useful in his prime but hasn't won since 2022; refused to race in a recent point
runners.name: Fat Sam
runners.spotlight: Good-ground specialist who was useful in his prime for Chris Down; without a win since 2022, though, and recent point form for David Dennis is not inspiring (refused to race on latest appearance).

runners.comment: Didn't fire over hurdles last time but ran well in his latest chase; visor now added
runners.name: Chief Black Robe
runners.spotlight: Needs to rebound quickly from a poor hurdle run 16 days ago but last month's second over fences at Market Rasen (2m3f, soft) was a pretty good effort and the forecast faster ground here ought to suit him better; big player if first-time visor has desired effect.

runners.comment: Well handicapped on old form; yet to hit top gear since a long layoff but still considered
runners.name: Line Of Descent
runners.spotlight: Three-time chase winner who is well handicapped on old form and returned from long absence with fairly encouraging run in February; only third best on merit when well-held second of five at Doncaster (2m3f, good) later that month but still considered here.

runners.comment: Won twice (once over C&D) in the autumn; subsequent defeat on heavy ground excusable
runners.name: Lelant
runners.spotlight: Returned from break with good-ground C&D win in October and followed up at Market Rasen (2m5f, good to soft) a few weeks later; struggled on heavy ground at Fontwell in December but has been freshened up again since and Sean Bowen keeps the ride; must be considered.

runners.comment: Ended 2025 with two disappointing hurdle runs; had wind op during break; cheekpieces on
runners.name: Warners Cross
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on chasing debut in summer 2024 but returned from long absence with two disappointing hurdle runs towards end of last year; had wind op during latest 113-day break and now sports first-time cheekpieces; current ability hard to gauge.

runners.comment: Pulled up on chasing debut but has since run well over hurdles; a possible
runners.name: Black Occ
runners.owner: P Conway T Lewis & G Wilson
runners.spotlight: 0-8 under rules; pulled up on chasing debut in January (wore cheekpieces) but ran quite well when third of six over hurdles here (3m1f, good; no headgear) this month and has possibilities if able to build on that effort back over fences.

runners.comment: Ended 2025 with two non-completions and his record when fresh is not good
runners.name: Boys Of Wexford
runners.spotlight: Dual chase winner; seemingly back in good nick when second at Fontwell (2m3f, good to soft) in November but ended 2025 with two non-completions and his record when fresh is not good; others preferred.

runners.comment: Didn't run badly when fourth at Leicester this month but is 0-23 under rules now
runners.name: Ultra Viers
runners.spotlight: Didn't run badly when last of four finishers at Leicester (2m4f, good to soft; just behind Jack Doyen) this month, after a break, and will be suited by this forecast good ground but he's 0-23 under rules and remains difficult to enthuse over.

runners.comment: Yet to add to win in 2024 edition of this race but returns here after two respectable runs
runners.name: Jack Doyen
runners.spotlight: On the downgrade now and yet to add to his win in 2024 edition of this race (soft ground) but returns here after two respectable runs, the latter a third at Leicester (2m4f, good to soft) 19 days ago, and should be fine on this quicker surface; 1lb wrong.

15:00.race_name: CB Security & Protection Services Handicap Chase

runners.breeder: Messrs M E & A D I Harris
runners.comment: Reliable 11yo who won this off 1lb lower last year; worth considering back from a break.
runners.name: Chestnut Pete
runners.spotlight: Reliable veteran who was in good form when last seen, finishing third on his last three runs; won this off 1lb lower last year and he's worth considering back from a break.

runners.comment: 5lb rise might make him vulnerable for the win, but he shouldn't be far away.
runners.name: Blackijo Dagrostis
runners.spotlight: 0-12 under rules but recent efforts over fences have been respectable, latest when a 3.25l third of six at Taunton (2m, good); back up 5lb which will likely make him vulnerable for the win, but he shouldn't be far away.

runners.breeder: S A R L Ecurie Lafeu
runners.comment: Narrowly denied a first win in seven years latest; strong claims if repeating that effort.
runners.name: Ballywood
runners.spotlight: Came very close to a first win in seven years when narrowly denied at Huntingdon (2m, good) seven days ago; can race keenly and unlikely to get an easy lead here, but worth considering if reproducing that effort off the same mark.

runners.comment: Needs to bounce back from a modest run latest, but interesting with Sean Bowen booked.
runners.name: McGrath From Clune
runners.spotlight: C&D winner in November and ran well when second at Newcastle (2m, good to soft) 11 days later; looked the likeliest winner before unseating late at Taunton in December and now needs to bounce back from a disappointing run at Fontwell on Boxing Day (jumped right); tough mark but remains of interest with Sean Bowen booked.

runners.comment: Unexposed and may do better in time, but others have more pressing claims here.
runners.name: Quinta Brigada
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in three runs over hurdles (2m-2m3f) and finished a 38l fourth of five on last month's chase/handicap debut at Ffos Las (2m, heavy); may do better in time but others have more obvious claims.

runners.comment: Surprise winner over C&D last week; carries a penalty but could figure if in similar mood.
runners.name: The Brickey Ranger
runners.spotlight: Struggled in handicaps for previous yard over a range of trips up to 3m2f this season since returning from a long absence, but capitalised on a reduced mark when winning over C&D last week on stable debut, ridden by Jess Stewart; carries a penalty but could figure if reproducing that effort.

15:30.race_name: Hereford Quarries Mares' "National Hunt" Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Always behind in novice here on debut; significantly more is required
runners.name: Crystal Box
runners.spotlight: 80-1, always behind when 11th of 13 in novice here (2m, soft) on her debut last month; significantly more is required from this daughter of Crystal Ocean.

runners.comment: Well-held debut sixth in bumper at Warwick; could still take step forward now hurdling
runners.name: Davita Blaze
runners.spotlight: Sent off 4-1 but she came in a well-held sixth of eight in bumper at Warwick on her debut 33 days ago; this Jet Away mare could take a step forward now going hurdling.

runners.comment: Hinted at promise with third in Ffos Las bumper latest; winning pointer; can build on it
runners.name: Johnnys Belle
runners.spotlight: Malinas mare who hinted at promise when third of five in a Ffos Las bumper (15-2) nine days ago; this winning pointer can take a step forward.

runners.breeder: S C E A De La Vallee De LOrne
runners.comment: Won French bumper; tailed off in Newbury Listed bumper last February; may still do better
runners.name: Kernie dAiry
runners.spotlight: A £155,000 purchase after winning a bumper at Durtal in November 2024 for Hugo Merienne; beat only one on her yard debut in Newbury Listed bumper 13 months ago but she's in very good hands so could still do better now going hurdling.

runners.comment: Kayf Tara mare; a three-time winner in points, latest in February; must enter calculations
runners.name: LAventara
runners.spotlight: Kayf Tara mare who is a three-time winner in points, latest in February; she must enter calculations now starting out in this sphere.

runners.comment: Fair form shown in bumpers but she's failed to show that since sent hurdling
runners.name: Svelte Silhouette
runners.spotlight: Fair form shown in bumpers but she's failed to show that since sent hurdling, only ninth of 13 in 1m7f Wincanton novice 20 days ago; not easy to make a case for.

runners.comment: Pulled up on first go over hurdles at Doncaster; lots more is needed
runners.name: Tierbay
runners.spotlight: 300-1, jumped ponderously when pulled up on her first go over hurdles in novice at Doncaster (2m3f, soft) in January; lots more is needed from this Frontiersman mare.

runners.comment: Fairly useful in bumpers in 2022; raced very infrequently since though and little promise
runners.name: Tipperary Star
runners.spotlight: Fairly useful form shown when placed in bumpers in 2022; raced very infrequently since though and she came in a well-held ninth over 2m here in February before early fall at Huntingdon a week ago; hard to warm to.

runners.comment: Shaped well when third here latest; should prove well suited by longer trip; big shout
runners.name: Isabella Islay
runners.spotlight: Much improved from her debut ninth when a running-on third of nine in 2m juvenile hurdle here last month; this Scalo filly should prove well suited by this longer distance; holds leading claims.

runners.breeder: Mill House Stud & Mr N Farrell
runners.comment: Encouraging Wetherby fifth last month; she can take a step forward up in trip; considered
runners.name: Millady
runners.spotlight: Nathaniel mare who shaped encouragingly when fifth of seven in juvenile at Wetherby (2m, soft) on her first go over hurdles last month; she can take a step forward now upped in trip; needs considering.

runners.comment: Not obviously thrown in on handicap debut, but recent efforts have been encouraging.
runners.name: Arnie Moon
runners.spotlight: Shaped encouragingly on his second hurdle start and ran creditably in a deeper maiden when sixth of 13 at Taunton (2m3f, good to soft) in January; despite top weight, he's worth a close look on handicap debut now back in trip, with Callum Pritchard's 3lb claim also a plus.

runners.breeder: V & F Berouards Haras Des Sablonnets &
runners.comment: Produced a career-best latest; tougher task off 4lb higher but still open to progress.
runners.name: Best Night
runners.spotlight: Produced a career best when winning at Huntingdon two-weeks ago back from a short break; faces a tougher task off 4lb higher, but she's open to further improvement, with conditions ideal.

runners.comment: Yet to reproduce her French form but makes handicap debut at an ordinary level; respected.
runners.name: Madame De Labrunie
runners.spotlight: 1-8 in France, her sole win coming in a claimer; outclassed on British debut in a mares' Listed contest, and has failed to reproduce her French form in two runs in juveniles since; however, she's not too badly treated now switching to handicaps at an ordinary level and looks interesting.

runners.comment: Drops in trip and back on better ground, with new headgear, but has too much to prove.
runners.name: Directly
runners.spotlight: Modest maiden hurdler, pulled up since a heavy defeat on January's handicap debut; drops back in trip and returns to better ground, with cheekpieces and a tongue-tie added, but has plenty to prove.

runners.breeder: His Highness The Aga Khans Studs S C
runners.comment: Yet to build on an encouraging return but is on a handy mark.
runners.name: Kotgar
runners.spotlight: Has failed to build on an encouraging reappearance at Ffos Las in October, finishing tailed off in November and pulled up the following month; absent since, but returns on a handy mark, albeit with something to prove.

runners.breeder: Patrice Vagne & Haras De Saint Voir
runners.comment: Tailed off latest and needs this switch to handicaps to spark significant improvement.
runners.name: Inca
runners.spotlight: Finished second in an Irish Point in May 2023, but has failed to show any notable form in three runs over hurdles, most recently finishing tailed off at Market Rasen (2m2f, good to soft) in January; makes handicap debut.

runners.comment: Pulled up latest and difficult to make a case for from out of the weights.
runners.name: Ramaah
runners.spotlight: 1m5f AW Flat winner who has only shown a modest level of ability in 11 runs over hurdles (2m-2m3f); latest when pulled up at Huntingdon (good to soft) this month; hard to recommend from out of the weights.

runners.comment: Has held her form well since winning last June and she's likely to make her presence felt.
runners.name: Land Girls Luck
runners.spotlight: Dual 2m4f hurdle winner last June and she's held her from well since, most recently back from a 151-day break when a 2.5l second at Hereford 18-days ago ridden by Aimee Jones; likely to make her presence felt again off an unchanged mark.

runners.comment: Recent run after wind surgery was more encouraging but she'll need to build on that.
runners.name: Midnight Ginger
runners.spotlight: Struggling for form this season, but last month's fourth at Warwick (2m3f, soft) following wind surgery was more encouraging, albeit beaten 18l; another step forward will be required, but she's on a good mark if doing so.

runners.comment: Disappointed on last month's handicap debut and seems on a tough mark.
runners.name: Broadway Honey
runners.spotlight: Showed glimpses of ability in maiden/novice company over hurdles (2m-2m6f; good/good to soft), but proved disappointing when switched to handicaps last time at Ludlow (2m5f); may do better in time but she doesn't appear to be particularly well treated despite being 4lb lower here.

runners.comment: Shaped batter than the bare result on both starts in handicaps and one to consider.
runners.name: Border Gem
runners.spotlight: Not beaten far in any of her hurdles, latterly in two handicaps, shaping better than the bare result on both occasions, latest at Taunton (2m3f, good) in December when losing her pitch leaving the back straight before staying on again; one to consider off 3lb lower.

runners.comment: Remains on a stiff enough mark despite the 3lb drop; cheekpieces now added.
runners.name: Hey Flint
runners.spotlight: Didn't really achieve too much in her qualifying runs and never figured when pulled up on her handicap debut over C&D (good) 18-days ago; remains on a tough mark despite the 3lb drop; cheekpieces now added.

runners.comment: Back to form on this month's stable debut and a leading candidate off an unchanged mark.
runners.name: Reel Orange
runners.owner: J M Dare T Hamlin J W Snook
runners.spotlight: 0-7 over hurdles and out of sorts for previous stable on two runs following wind surgery, but came back to somewhere near best when well supported and finishing second on this month's stable debut at Exeter (2m2f, good to soft); leading candidate off the same mark.

runners.breeder: M Larobe P Thiriet & R Gourmau
runners.comment: Lightly raced 4yo maiden who may be suited by this longer trip; worth considering.
runners.name: Miss Carbo
runners.spotlight: Has yet to build on her initial promise, albeit was highly tried on one occasion, but her pedigree suggests she may be suited by this longer trip and she's far from exposed; down 5lb and hard to dismiss with her age allowance, despite disappointing on this month's handicap debut.

runners.comment: Tongue tied but showed little when co-favourite on stable debut at Taunton yesterday
runners.name: Miss Fedora
runners.spotlight: Signs of a revival when fourth at Fakenham (2m5f) in January, before finding 3m5f beyond her (refused at the final fence) on final start for Seamus Mullins; tongue tied but showed little when co-favourite on stable debut at Taunton yesterday; this would be her first hurdle race since 2024 were she to run again.

17:05.race_name: Richard Layton Charity Day 16th April NH Flat Race (Amateur/Conditionals') (Cat 2 Elimination) (GBB)

runners.comment: Off since winning a Southwell bumper in December 2024; major player on return.
runners.name: One Knight
runners.spotlight: Left behind an underwhelming debut when making all to win a Southwell (good to soft) bumper for new stable and ridden by Cameron Johnstone-Baker in December 2024, posting a useful RPR; key player if ready to roll after a 477-day absence.

runners.breeder: S C E A De La Vallee De LOrne
runners.comment: Half-brother to useful hurdle/chase winner Issar D'Airy; respected on debut; major yard.
runners.name: Legend DAiry
runners.spotlight: 48,000euros 3yo, half-brother to useful 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase winner Issar D'Airy; of obvious interest for his leading stable on debut, especially if strong in the market.

runners.comment: Hinted at ability on last month's debut but possibly one for further down the road.
runners.name: Mac J
runners.spotlight: First foal of a 2m6f hurdle winner; finished a 23l seventh of eight at Huntingdon (2m, soft) last month; possibly one for the further down the road.

runners.comment: Flat-bred son of Night of Thunder who is probably best watched on debut.
runners.name: Thunderous Sea
runners.spotlight: Flat-bred son of Night Of Thunder; half-brother to 1m winner Glencalvie, dam a half-sister to smart winners English Oak (7f/1m) and Forest Of Dean (1m2f Group 3); stable 0-36 in bumpers over the past five years and probably best watched on debut.

runners.comment: Irish mares' point winner last year, but beaten 33l on bumper/stable debut in January.
runners.name: Britway Belle
runners.spotlight: Won Irish mares' maiden point (3m, yielding) on debut in October and subsequently changed hands for £120,000 but beaten 33l on January's rules debut (soft, 12-1); more required but the better ground may help.

runners.comment: Dam related to a couple of winners but likely one for the longer term.
runners.name: Great Oak Lad
runners.spotlight: Sixth foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Felix Younger (bumper and high-class 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase) and My Valley (bumper, 1m4f-2m Flat and 2m hurdle); perhaps one for the longer term.

runners.comment: Half-brother to several winners; showed ability on last month's debut; may improve.
runners.name: Mac Gayveur
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to several winners and displayed some ability when a 25l sixth of 11 at Southwell (soft) on last month's debut; one of two for the stable.

runners.comment: £7,000 3yo; brother to a couple of bumper winners; market best guide.
runners.name: Strong Man Tom
runners.spotlight: £7,000 3yo; sixth foal; brother to bumpers winners Peace Motivator and Peace Belle, half-brother to 2m/2m3f hurdle winner Simply Red; check the betting.

runners.comment: Sister to the useful Masters Legacy but she was well held on last month's debut.
runners.name: Gentora
runners.spotlight: Sister to the useful 2m-3m hurdle/chase winner Masters Legacy; 20-1 when finishing a 26l fifth of eight at Warwick on heavy ground last month; others make more obvious appeal but she's another who may be suited by good ground; one of two for the stable

runners.comment: Ten-race maiden who has lost his way and was beaten 14l over C&D last time
runners.name: Rory Rocket
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on his second at Goodwood (6f, good) last August but he's lost his way in last four runs and was beaten 14l over C&D three weeks ago; record is now 0-10 and he has a lot to prove from tough draw.

runners.comment: On reduced mark but he's 0-6 on AW and was well held over C&D on recent stable debut
runners.name: Sub Thirteen
runners.spotlight: Four-time turf winner but he's 0-6 on AW and was well held over C&D on his stable debut three weeks ago; continues to drop down the weights but he's drawn out wide here and others are preferred; cheekpieces added.

runners.comment: 0-13 but she returned from a break with a good third over C&D three weeks ago; respected
runners.name: Rye
runners.spotlight: 0-13 but runner-up twice in a row at Wolverhampton in the autumn and she returned from a break with creditable third over C&D three weeks ago; had some of today's rivals behind her last time and she's a big payer if she can build on that run.

runners.comment: Hard to predict but he went close at Lingfield on penultimate run; hood now tried
runners.name: Just Jump
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 19 starts was over 1m (soft) in Ireland last October; has mixed record since but he's not been with Tony Carroll for long and was a close third at Lingfield (6f, Polytrack) on his penultimate run; has possibilities if he can recapture that form and he's in the mix in new headgear.

runners.comment: Record of 0-19 and has been well held in both runs for current yard; tongue-tie on
runners.name: Valsharah
runners.spotlight: Free-going 4yo who is 0-19 and has been well held in two runs (7f/5f) for Mick Appleby this year; had a wide trip at Wolverhampton last time but he needs to raise his game on his step back up to 6f; hood removed and tongue-tie is now tried.

runners.comment: Won at Wolverhampton in January and he had some traffic issues last time; dangerous
runners.name: Hes An Angel
runners.spotlight: Came from off the pace to win over this trip at Wolverhampton in January; finished down the field in three subsequent runs but he had some traffic issues in a messy race at Southwell last time; now only 2lb higher than for his last success and has claims if he gets some luck.

runners.comment: Won off similar mark here in January and he's not ruled out on this return to sprinting
runners.name: Mighty Ruler
runners.spotlight: Just one win from 17 starts but that came off a similar mark here (7f) in January; no impact in last four runs but he ran well for a long way at Wolverhampton last time and is not ruled out on this drop back to 6f.

runners.breeder: His Highness The Aga Khans Studs S C
runners.comment: Habitual slow starter who is 0-23 in Britain and has struggled in his last two starts
runners.name: Haziym
runners.spotlight: Habitual slow starter who is 0-23 in Britain; perked up with a close third over C&D (20-1) in December but he's struggled in last two runs and others carry fewer risks.

runners.comment: Frequent slow starter but he won over 7f here on his penultimate run; dangerous
runners.name: Vitalline
runners.spotlight: Frequent slow starter who was always on the back foot over C&D last time but he justified favouritism here (7f classified) on his penultimate run; still looks feasibly treated on that form and has claims if this sets up for his closing style.

runners.comment: Close fourth over C&D in his final run for Mike Murphy; needs a close look for new yard
runners.name: Horus
runners.spotlight: Sole win was in December 2024 but he finished close fourth over C&D in January, on his final run for Mike Murphy; been gelded since and he needs a close look on his return for new yard; visor goes on and tongue-tie and cheekpieces are removed.

runners.comment: Fair efforts over 5f in last two runs but it's almost three years since his sole success
runners.name: Battle Point
runners.spotlight: Respectable efforts in classified events (5f) in last two runs but it's almost three years since his sole win and others are preferred; one of three runners for the yard.

runners.comment: Unexposed 4yo but he's struggled for current yard and has looked a tricky customer
runners.name: Daddy Chill
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 4yo but he has a mixed record so far and was last of eight in a Lingfield handicap (1m) three weeks ago; dropped 5lb but he's looked a tricky customer in three runs for his current yard and has plenty to prove; cheekpieces added.

runners.comment: Has form figures of 141333 since December and he's strongly respected back up in trip
runners.name: Homme De Fer
runners.spotlight: Won over 7f at Wolverhampton and Lingfield in December and he's held his form with placed efforts in last three runs including a close call over C&D in January; still looks on a workable mark and he's strongly respected back up in trip.

runners.comment: Went very close over C&D in January and is a big player if he can repeat that form
runners.name: Whiskey Sunrise
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden but he finished well to go very close over C&D (11-2) in January; only 1lb higher after a short break and he's a big player if he can repeat that latest form.

runners.comment: Didn't fire latest but he still has potential and could resume his progress after a break
runners.name: Timely Affair
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who won a classified event at Southwell (1m) in January but he didn't fire in a handicap there 16 days later; needs to step up again after that but he still has potential and could resume his progress after a short break.

runners.comment: Has struggled in all four runs and he needs a transformation back up in trip
runners.name: Harry Dont Bite
runners.spotlight: Finished in rear at big prices in his three qualifying runs and same story on handicap debut at Lingfield (7f) last month; still early days but he needs a transformation back up in trip.

runners.breeder: David John Brown & Whistbury Manor Stud
runners.comment: Made the breakthrough at Southwell (7f) last month but he was well held there last time
runners.name: Aim For The Bull
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the 20th attempt when landing a classified event at Southwell (7f) last month; ran right up to his best with that success but he's not easy to predict and was well held in a Southwell handicap two weeks ago; others preferred.

runners.comment: Close second at Lingfield last month but was well held last time and he's now 0-21
runners.name: Unknown Journey
runners.spotlight: 21-race maiden; returned to form with a close second in classified event at Lingfield (1m) last month but he failed to back that up at Wolverhampton two weeks ago; hood is now added and he needs to bounce back again after that last run.

runners.comment: Nine-race maiden who has been well held in classified events in last three runs; opposable
runners.name: Resilient Lady
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden who has yet to be placed and has been well held in classified events in her last three runs; opposable.

runners.comment: Eight-race maiden who has not finished closer than fifth and she needs improvement
runners.name: Petra Grey
runners.spotlight: Has not finished closer than fifth in her eight starts, including two handicaps and two classified events for current yard; made some late headway in blinkers here (7f) last time but she needs improvement back up in trip.

runners.comment: Won in Ireland last summer but she's been disappointing since and record is now 1-16
runners.name: Purple Sky
runners.spotlight: Won at Down Royal (10.6f, good) last July but she's not come close to that form since and has been quiet in three runs for new yard this year; record is now 1-16 and others are preferred.

runners.comment: 0-16 but she went close off this mark at Southwell (1m) on Saturday; key player
runners.name: Volendam
runners.spotlight: 0-16 but she's finished runner-up in three of her last four starts including a close call at Southwell (1m) on Saturday; on same mark and she's a big player again back on Polytrack.

runners.comment: Inconsistent mare who is 1-17 and was beaten 17l at Southwell last time
runners.name: Grand Citadel
runners.spotlight: Won on turf (7f, good to soft) last spring but she's been lightly raced since and was beaten 17l at Southwell last month; now back on her winning mark but she needs a major revival back up in trip; blinkers reapplied.

runners.breeder: Mrs S Bunney & Mr P Taplin
runners.comment: 0-19 but was an eye-catcher at Wolverhampton and she looks interesting back up in trip
runners.name: Whiteley Way
runners.spotlight: 19-race maiden but she's on a reduced mark and was beaten less than 2l when fifth at Wolverhampton (7f) last month; that was an eye-catching effort after a slow start and she's an interesting contender back up in trip.

runners.breeder: R C Dollar & Hellwood Stud Farm
runners.comment: Won over C&D and at Wolverhampton last month and she had an excuse last time; dangerous
runners.name: Port Noir
runners.spotlight: Got back in the groove when winning over C&D and at Wolverhampton (8.6f) last month; didn't fire in hat-trick bid at Wolverhampton three weeks ago but that was from a wide draw and she still looks on a workable mark; dangerous if things go more to plan this time.

runners.comment: Last-gasp win at Wolverhampton in January but she's not matched that form since
runners.name: Scenario
runners.spotlight: Won at Wolverhampton (9.4f) in January but that was a last-gasp success and she's not matched that form since; ran respectably when fourth at Southwell (1m) last time but she needs to find more back on Polytrack.

runners.comment: Both wins have been over 1m2f but he was runner-up over C&D last time; respected
runners.name: Dubai Harbour
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been over 1m2f at Lingfield (AW) but he gave it a good shot when runner-up over C&D three weeks ago; on unchanged mark and he should be in the thick of things again.

runners.comment: Losing run is up to 12 and she's been well held after slow starts in her last two runs
runners.name: Boujee Gold
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on her Brighton win last spring but she's 0-12 since and has been well held after slow starts on Tapeta (9.4f/1m) in last two runs; headgear is now removed and she needs to rediscover her spark.

runners.comment: Sole win was in July 2023 and he's not finished closer than sixth since then; opposable
runners.name: Senseofentitlement
runners.owner: Miss M P Bryant David & Eileen Bryant
runners.spotlight: His sole win was in July 2023 and he's not finished closer than sixth in 13 runs since then; opposable.

18:30.race_name: Virgin Bet Restricted Maiden Stakes (For Horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)

runners.breeder: S A R L Haras Du Mont Dit Mont
runners.comment: Flat-bred gelding; raced three times in bumpers, failing to back up form of debut win
runners.name: Pureis King
runners.spotlight: Flat-bred gelding who has raced three times in turf bumpers, failing to back up the form of his debut success; chance depends on how well he responds to the change of code, trip and surface.

runners.comment: Down the field in bumpers; fared a lot better (close second) in 7f Flat event at Southwell
runners.name: Receipt
runners.spotlight: Down the field in two bumpers for Tom Ellis; has rejoined that trainer since faring a lot better (close second) in 7f AW Flat event at Southwell for Pam Sly; may build on that effort.

runners.comment: Brings solid form, with her two Lingfield efforts subsequently franked by the winners
runners.name: Freda
runners.spotlight: Brings solid form, with her two Lingfield efforts (1m/7f) subsequently franked by the winners; beaten only half a length on debut; failed to show progress last time but may still do better.

runners.comment: £44,000 yearling; bred to act well on the surface; may show promise
runners.name: Eagle Thunder
runners.spotlight: £44,000 yearling; Sergei Prokofiev half-brother to 7f winner One Night Thunder (including AW; RPR 93), out of 6f AW scorer (91); this debutant is bred to act well on the surface; may show promise.

runners.comment: In good hands and, judged on breeding, should be suited by the surface; shortlisted
runners.name: Enemy Agent
runners.spotlight: Earthlight half-brother to French winners Kind Of Kiss (1m2f; RPR 94) and Forelsket (1m/9.5f AW; 88); dam 7f AW/9.5f turf Listed scorer (101); in good hands and should be suited by the surface; shortlisted.

runners.comment: Saxon Warrior half-brother to three winners; check the betting
runners.name: Franschhoek
runners.spotlight: Saxon Warrior half-brother to three winners, notably Woodhay Wonder (multiple 6f; RPR 107); dam 7f/8.6f AW scorer (76), out of US 1m3f Grade 2 winner; check the betting.

runners.comment: 62,000euros foal; bred to take well to artificial surfaces; interesting debutant
runners.name: Generic
runners.spotlight: 62,000euros foal; Kameko half-brother to French Group-placed 1m1f AW/10.5f turf winner Crohanne (RPR 103); dam 1m2f AW scorer (77), closely related to UAE 1m/9.5f dirt Group 2 winner Military Law; bred to take well to artificial surfaces; notable connections; interesting debutant.

runners.comment: Son of Australia; market may prove best guide as regards this Prescott newcomer
runners.name: Pace Attack
runners.spotlight: 36,000euros yearling, resold 50,000gns later in 2024; Australia half-brother to 7f winner Livio Milo (RPR 90); dam 6f/7f scorer (99); market may prove best guide as regards this Prescott newcomer.

runners.comment: 65,000euros yearling; wears hood on debut; probably best watched
runners.name: Miss Guinevere
runners.spotlight: 65,000euros yearling; by Camelot and first foal of 6f 2yo/1m winner (RPR 99); wears hood on debut; probably best watched unless the betting suggests otherwise.

runners.breeder: J Bernstein/R Haim/Manton Park Farms Ltd
runners.comment: Last of 12 in 7f contest at Kempton (wore hood; now removed)
runners.name: Midnight Media
runners.spotlight: Brings the worst form, having finished last of 12 in 7f contest at Kempton; hood worn on that occasion is now removed.

runners.comment: Shaped with promise, amid greenness, in 1m event at Lingfield
runners.name: The Bureau Club
runners.spotlight: Shaped with some promise, amid greenness, in 1m event at Lingfield; recorded only a modest RPR with that fourth of five but may do better with the experience under her belt.

19:00.race_name: Virgin Bet A Good Bet Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: Good third at Kempton on final 2yo start; may take another step forward; possibilities
runners.name: Blues And Royals
runners.owner: D Fish S Jones & J Barnett
runners.spotlight: Good third at Kempton (7f; AW debut) on final 2yo start; gelded since; may take another step forward kept to this venue on handicap debut; possibilities.

runners.comment: Gelded prior to prevailing narrowly at Chelmsford on handicap/seasonal debut
runners.name: Just A Gambler
runners.spotlight: Gelded prior to prevailing narrowly at Chelmsford (1m) on handicap/seasonal debut; now 3lb higher in a deeper race but may be capable of further progress.

runners.comment: Seemingly not straightforward but otherwise a nicely bred sort who may improve further
runners.name: Thestral
runners.spotlight: Seemingly not straightforward as he's been gelded since Newcastle novice win (7f) and now goes in headgear; otherwise a nicely bred sort who may improve further.

runners.comment: Leaves the impression he'll be suited by this new trip on handicap debut; interesting
runners.name: Heart Sign
runners.spotlight: Has shown clear promise over 7f, while leaving the impression he'll be suited by this extra furlong on handicap debut and second start for new yard; interesting contender.

runners.comment: Contrasting performances since wearing blinkers; mixed messages
runners.name: Ebn Sabt
runners.spotlight: Contrasting performances since fitted with blinkers, winning at Lingfield (1m) then last of four at Southwell; mixed messages, with the blinds retained.

runners.comment: Improved form this year, making all over C&D then second at Wolverhampton
runners.name: Hamaleel
runners.spotlight: Has taken her form to a new level this year, making all over C&D then creditable second at Wolverhampton (8.5f); another easy lead would cement her respectable claims.

runners.comment: Boughey runner who looks the type to improve now handicapping; one to note
runners.name: Armstrong
runners.spotlight: Disappointing on final start last summer (gelded since) but has otherwise shown some promise and this Boughey runner looks the type to improve now handicapping; one to note.

runners.comment: Failed to beat a rival on handicap debut when last seen
runners.name: Gnocchi
runners.spotlight: Failed to beat a rival on handicap debut (6f, turf) when last seen and is best watched unless the market suggests a bigger effort is likely.

runners.comment: Triple silver medallist who may earn gold over this new trip; dam multiple 1m winner
runners.name: Station Bar
runners.spotlight: Ended his 2yo season with a trio of second-place finishes over shorter; solid contender and may go one better over this new trip, being out of a multiple 1m winner for his connections.

runners.comment: Superstar hurdler on his day; impressive at Southwell on Flat debut; sets a tall standard
runners.name: Constitution Hill
runners.spotlight: Superstar hurdler on his day and one of the best-known horses in training; having developed serious jumping issues, he was switched to the Flat in Southwell contest (1m4f) last month and showed his class by producing an impressive performance that is backed up by the figures; sets a tall standard en route to Group targets.

runners.comment: Once-raced winner who is open to progress and looks one of the brighter contenders
runners.name: Classical Allusion
runners.spotlight: Gained his Southwell 1m4f success six months ago in a time over three seconds slower than Constitution Hill recorded over the same C&D last month; however, this once-raced gelding is open to progress and, being so unexposed, looks one of the brighter opponents to the Henderson star.

runners.comment: May do better over this trip but handicaps are likely to be his ideal scene
runners.name: Edward Sexton
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner who has perhaps found 7f/1m in adequate in his modest Flat attempts; may do better over this longer trip but handicaps are likely to be his ideal scene.

runners.comment: Useful hurdler; runner-up at Southwell in latest Flat start; again has place claims
runners.name: Roadlesstravelled
runners.spotlight: Useful, having shown best hurdles form with Grade 2 novice win; not in same league as Constitution Hill in that sphere and duly proved no threat to that rival at Southwell on Flat debut, finishing midfield; bagged a silver medal there (1m3f) since, however, and again has place claims.

runners.comment: Finished behind Constitution Hill and Roadlesstravelled at Southwell on Flat debut
runners.name: Star Artist
runners.spotlight: Vastly inferior to Constitution Hill and Roadlesstravelled over hurdles; duly finished behind those two opponents at Southwell on the switch to this code; faces another stiff task.

runners.comment: Finished behind Roadlesstravelled at Southwell on return to the Flat
runners.name: Victors Spirit
runners.owner: The Ridgeway Racing For Fun Partnership
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in two bumpers but a faller in both attempts over hurdles; finished behind Roadlesstravelled at Southwell on return to the Flat, recording an ordinary RPR; plenty to find.

runners.comment: Showed some ability in autumn 2024 for Owen Burrows; heed the market signals
runners.name: Serviceman
runners.spotlight: Showed some ability (RPRs 70 and 69) in maidens over 1m on turf and 1m2f on AW in autumn 2024 for Owen Burrows; absent and gelded since; has joined Andrew Balding, who also runs Classical Allusion; possibly open to improvement; the betting may offer further guidance.

runners.comment: Modest maiden hurdler; runner-up at Wolverhampton last week on Flat debut
runners.name: Keep It Cool
runners.spotlight: Modest maiden hurdler; fared best of the rest behind easy winner at Wolverhampton (8.5f) last week on Flat debut, shaping as if this longer trip will suit; needs big improvement on form, however.

20:00.race_name: Virgin Bet Daily Price Boosts Handicap (London Stayers' Series Qualifier) (GBBPlus Race)

runners.comment: Four-time winner on turf but is less solid on AW form
runners.name: High Point
runners.spotlight: Achieved little over hurdles the last twice; four-time winner on Flat turf but is less solid on AW form and doesn't seem set to defy top weight.

runners.comment: Took advantage of handy hurdles mark last time; 2-2 over C&D; commands respect
runners.name: Knight Templar
runners.spotlight: Took his C&D record to 2-2 with a success in January and posted a solid effort at Southwell in most recent Flat outing; took advantage of a handy hurdles mark since; respected.

runners.comment: Consistent; creditable efforts at Lingfield this year; C&D record reads 312; solid
runners.name: Naasma
runners.spotlight: Consistent mare who scored three times at Windsor (11.5f) last term and has posted two creditable efforts at Lingfield (latest over 2m) this year; C&D record reads 312; solid claims.

runners.comment: Still a maiden but latest effort suggests this new trip may suit; possibilities
runners.name: Sword Of Wessex
runners.spotlight: Still a maiden after ten attempts but his rallying effort over 1m5f at Lingfield (second start for new yard) most recently suggests this new trip may suit; possibilities off reduced mark.

runners.comment: On a long losing spell and isn't the force of old
runners.name: Fleurman
runners.spotlight: On a long losing spell, not the force of old and his record for current yard is far from solid; others preferred.

20:30.race_name: Virgin Bet Daily Extra Places Handicap

runners.comment: Resumes 4lb above his highest winning mark; this is easier back on AW (won nursery here)
runners.name: Mr Ubiquitous
runners.spotlight: Won four on turf last spring/summer (7f-1m), climbing the weights by more than a stone, before losing his way latterly; resumes 4lb above his highest successful mark, back from seven months off, but this is easier back on the AW (won his nursery here).

runners.comment: Cheekpieces haven't helped this year and he's still to convince over this longer trip
runners.name: Mr Cool
runners.spotlight: Two turf wins last spring/summer came over 6f off higher marks; cheekpieces haven't helped this year and he's still to convince over this longer trip (needs to settle better than at Chelmsford last time).

runners.comment: Won three from the front over 6f last summer; gone well first time out more than once
runners.name: Safari Dream
runners.spotlight: Won three from the front over 6f early last summer, latterly off tonight's mark; Lewis Edmunds, who's often ridden him, partners Cypriot Diaspora, but he's gone well first time out more than once and the market will likely tell a tale.

runners.comment: Nothing to suggest she's best caught fresh; will need to improve on previous AW efforts
runners.name: Cypriot Diaspora
runners.spotlight: Dual Ffos Las winner over this trip last August who resumes on a workable mark having lost her way latterly; nothing to suggest she's best caught fresh and she'll need to improve on previous AW efforts.

runners.comment: Won for visor first going on last autumn (blinkers on); quite capable if the race sets up
runners.name: Mumayaz
runners.spotlight: Always needed things to fall just so given his run style; offered more at Wolverhampton last Monday, on his first run back with his old yard, and won with a visor first going on last autumn; first-time blinkers join his regular tongue-tie and quite capable if the race sets up for him.

runners.comment: More on his second run for this yard last time and is well treated now; 7f a bare minimum
runners.name: Terries Royale
runners.spotlight: Two wins for Michael Appleby came over a stiff 1m on soft ground; regressive since returning from a long absence but offered a bit more on his second run for this yard, who also saddle Mumayaz, last time and is well treated now.
